site.title: Everyday AI, Done Right
site.tagline: Real AI leverage. Actually free. No credit card.
site.audience: Anyone, anywhere, seeking practical 100% free AI workflows — no paid API keys, no credit card, no subscription tier
site.description: A verified directory of the highest-leverage, highest-value, highest-agency things an ordinary person can do with AI tools that are genuinely, currently free — checked against real provider docs, not vibes.

articles.title: Turn a 40-Page PDF Into Plain-Language Answers
articles.hook: Upload a dense 40-page form to Google AI Studio's free chat interface and get page-referenced, plain-language answers without paying $20/month for premium AI.
articles.tool: Google AI Studio (Gemini 1.5 Flash, free tier)

articles.title: Critique Your Resume Against a Real Job Description
articles.hook: Upload your resume PDF and a job description to Claude's free tier, get specific critique of what's wrong with each section, then rewrite the weak parts yourself.

articles.title: Turn Health Screenshots Into Pattern Reports
articles.hook: Upload a week's health app screenshots to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash on AI Studio and get back a structured day-by-day table with cross-metric pattern observations — free, no credit card.
articles.tool: Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google AI Studio, free tier)

articles.title: Turn a Raw Resume Into a Tailored Application
articles.hook: Tailor your resume and draft a precise cover letter for any job description using Google AI Studio's free tier, capped at 1,500 requests per day with no credit card required.
articles.tool: Google AI Studio (Gemini Flash model tier, free tier)
